ctaHeading: Craigieburn's mechanics are ready — let's fix your vehicle.
aboutText: With 35 years of experience, M.C.G Service Centre has been providing top-notch auto repair services in Craigieburn. Our skilled team specializes in clutch replacements, general servicing, and diagnostic work. We pride ourselves on honest pricing, quality workmanship, and a commitment to keeping the local community on the road.
servicesText: From clutch replacements to general servicing, we handle all aspects of vehicle maintenance. Our team uses the latest diagnostic tools to ensure accurate repairs and reliable performance for your car.

services.title: Clutch Repairs
services.desc: Expert clutch replacement and repair services for all vehicle types, ensuring smooth gear changes and optimal performance.

services.title: General Servicing
services.desc: Comprehensive vehicle servicing including oil changes, filter replacements, and safety checks to keep your car running smoothly.

services.title: Diagnostic Services
services.desc: Advanced diagnostic tools to accurately identify and fix electrical and mechanical issues in your vehicle.

services.title: Battery & Electrical
services.desc: Battery testing, replacement, and electrical system repairs to resolve starting and power issues.
